name: NH Audubon Nature Day Camp – Summer Camp
description_short: Weekly nature day camp, 9am to 4pm, at NH Audubon's McLane Center in Concord and Massabesic Center in Auburn. Campers are grouped by grade starting at kindergarten, and each week has a theme such as birds, watersheds, invertebrates or mammals.
refund_policy_summary: A $100 administrative fee applies to every cancellation. Cancel more than 14 days before the session for a full refund minus the fee; 7 to 14 days before, 50% back only if the spot is filled; under 7 days, no refund. Full refunds if NH Audubon cancels.

sessions.name: Session 1: Have to Have a Habitat (4 days)
